key: CAL: Seems like everything's settled then.
en: CAL: Seems like everything's settled then.
ja: キャル: これで全部片付いたみたいだね。

key: Thanks for your help as always, \PN.
en: Thanks for your help as always, \PN.
ja: いつも助けてくれてありがとう、\PN。

key: BLAKE: Uggggh, is it always like this with you guys?
en: BLAKE: Uggggh, is it always like this with you guys?
ja: ブレイク: うへぇ、お前らっていつもこんな感じなのかよ?

key: "Thank you for your assistance. We hope this experience has been mutually beneficial and blahblahblah--"
en: "Thank you for your assistance. We hope this experience has been mutually beneficial and blahblahblah--"
ja: 「ご協力ありがとうございました。この経験がお互いにとって有意義なものであったことを願います、うんぬんかんぬん――」

key: Bro, we just fought an erupting volcano and won!
en: Bro, we just fought an erupting volcano and won!
ja: なあ兄弟、俺たち今、噴火してる火山と戦って勝ったんだぞ!

key: That was sick!
en: That was sick!
ja: ヤバかったよな!

key: CAL: That isn't entirely accurate for a number of reasons, but...
en: CAL: That isn't entirely accurate for a number of reasons, but...
ja: キャル: 色々な意味で正確とは言い難いけど……

key: Yeah, it was all right.
en: Yeah, it was all right.
ja: まあ、悪くなかったよ。

key: BLAKE: Just "all right,"--
en: BLAKE: Just "all right,"--
ja: ブレイク: 「悪くなかった」、それだけかよ――

key: Well, sorryyyyy, next time we'll have to go fight two volcanoes at once, blindfolded, with our pants off.
en: Well, sorryyyyy, next time we'll have to go fight two volcanoes at once, blindfolded, with our pants off.
ja: はいはい悪かったな、次は目隠しでズボン脱いで、火山二つ同時に相手にしなきゃな。

key: Maybe then you can at least crack a smile.
en: Maybe then you can at least crack a smile.
ja: それならせめて、ちょっとくらい笑ってくれるか?

key: CAL: Okay, okay, I get the point.
en: CAL: Okay, okay, I get the point.
ja: キャル: 分かった分かった、言いたいことは分かるよ。

key: It's difficult to just let myself feel things sometimes.
en: It's difficult to just let myself feel things sometimes.
ja: 時々、素直に感情を出すのが難しいんだ。

key: BLAKE: What, they didn't teach you all that in hippie zen school?
en: BLAKE: What, they didn't teach you all that in hippie zen school?
ja: ブレイク: なんだよ、そのヒッピー禅スクールとやらじゃ教えてくれなかったのか?

key: CAL: I still had a lot to learn when...
en: CAL: I still had a lot to learn when...
ja: キャル: まだ学ぶことがたくさんあった頃に……

key: BLAKE: Riiiight, the whole Sensei thing.
en: BLAKE: Riiiight, the whole Sensei thing.
ja: ブレイク: ああ、あの「センセイ」がらみの話な。

key: Well, chin up.
en: Well, chin up.
ja: まあ、元気出せよ。

key: I'll be your teacher now.
en: I'll be your teacher now.
ja: これからは俺が先生になってやるよ。

key: CAL: You still have a lot to learn too.
en: CAL: You still have a lot to learn too.
ja: キャル: 君だって、まだまだ学ぶことがあるだろ。

key: BLAKE: Cold!
en: BLAKE: Cold!
ja: ブレイク: 冷てえな!

key: But you're right,
en: But you're right,
ja: でもまあ、その通りだ、

key: So you can be my teacher too.
en: So you can be my teacher too.
ja: だからお前も俺の先生ってことでいいぜ。

key: That's how learning works, right?
en: That's how learning works, right?
ja: 学びってそういうもんだろ?

key: Pretty sure I saw that on a poster once.
en: Pretty sure I saw that on a poster once.
ja: どっかのポスターで見た気がするしな。

key: Look, I'm new at this whole 'trying to be a good guy' thing.
en: Look, I'm new at this whole 'trying to be a good guy' thing.
ja: あのな、「良い奴になろう」ってのは、俺にとってまだ始めたばっかなんだ。

key: Work with me here?
en: Work with me here?
ja: だから、付き合ってくれよな?

key: CAL: Yeah. I can do that.
en: CAL: Yeah. I can do that.
ja: キャル: ああ。それくらいならできるよ。

key: BLAKE: Great, truce!
en: BLAKE: Great, truce!
ja: ブレイク: よし、じゃあ停戦だ!

key: Then I'd call this a big win.
en: Then I'd call this a big win.
ja: これは大勝利って呼んでいいよな。

key: No mountains melted into oblivion, nobody had to dunk me into a lava pool...
en: No mountains melted into oblivion, nobody had to dunk me into a lava pool...
ja: 山が跡形もなく溶けたわけでもないし、俺が溶岩に沈められたわけでもない……

key: Just good, clean hero work.
en: Just good, clean hero work.
ja: ただの、正々堂々としたヒーローの仕事ってわけだ。

key: Or something.
en: Or something.
ja: まあ、そんな感じ。

key: Anyway, I'm leaving before I acquire stage four bronchitis from this smoke.
en: Anyway, I'm leaving before I acquire stage four bronchitis from this smoke.
ja: とにかく、この煙で気管支炎ステージ4にならないうちに、俺は退散するぜ。

key: Dunno if it goes that high, but I don't wanna find out.
en: Dunno if it goes that high, but I don't wanna find out.
ja: そこまで進行するもんかは知らないが、確かめたくもねえしな。

key: You guys comin'?
en: You guys comin'?
ja: お前らも来るか?

key: CAL: Sure thing.
en: CAL: Sure thing.
ja: キャル: もちろん。

key: \PN, need a ride?
en: \PN, need a ride?
ja: \PN、乗っていくかい?

key: BLAKE: Then consider this popsicle stand blown.
en: BLAKE: Then consider this popsicle stand blown.
ja: ブレイク: なら、このアイス屋台は吹き飛んだも同然ってことでな。

key: Deuces.
en: Deuces.
ja: んじゃな。

key: BLAKE: Suit yourself.
en: BLAKE: Suit yourself.
ja: ブレイク: 好きにしろよ。

key: Don't come crying to me when your lungs fall out your asshole.
en: Don't come crying to me when your lungs fall out your asshole.
ja: 肺が尻から飛び出ても、俺のとこに泣きついてくるなよ。

key: BLAKE: Ugh, it really stinks down here...
en: BLAKE: Ugh, it really stinks down here...
ja: ブレイク: うへぇ、ここ、マジで臭いな……

key: CAL: The mountain is actively emitting toxic gas here.
en: CAL: The mountain is actively emitting toxic gas here.
ja: キャル: この山は今、有毒ガスをどんどん出してるんだ。

key: Try not to breathe too much of it if you can help it.
en: Try not to breathe too much of it if you can help it.
ja: できるだけ、あんまり吸い込まないようにね。

key: BLAKE: You really picked the worst type.
en: BLAKE: You really picked the worst type.
ja: ブレイク: お前、本当に最悪なタイプ選んだよな。

key: CAL: I'm not too happy about it myself.
en: CAL: I'm not too happy about it myself.
ja: キャル: 僕自身、あんまりうれしくはないよ。

key: BLAKE: Hello, what fresh hell now?!
en: BLAKE: Hello, what fresh hell now?!
ja: ブレイク: おいおい、今度は何の地獄だよ!?

key: CAL: The mountain must be melting to a point of no return!
en: CAL: The mountain must be melting to a point of no return!
ja: キャル: この山、もう後戻りできないところまで溶け始めてるんだ!

key: BLAKE: Don't think so!
en: BLAKE: Don't think so!
ja: ブレイク: そうはさせるかよ!

key: BLAKE: Walrein, keep a lid on it!
en: BLAKE: Walrein, keep a lid on it!
ja: ブレイク: トドゼルガ、こいつを抑え込め!

key: BLAKE: You guys are gonna need to find that Heatran on the double; I don't know how long we can hold this!
en: BLAKE: You guys are gonna need to find that Heatran on the double; I don't know how long we can hold this!
ja: ブレイク: お前らは急いでヒードランを見つけろ、こっちがいつまで持つか分からねえぞ!

key: And I'll be damned if I go soft to the hero's side just to lose it all now!
en: And I'll be damned if I go soft to the hero's side just to lose it all now!
ja: ヒーロー側に寝返ったってのに、ここで全部台無しにされてたまるかよ!

key: CAL: Looks like the locals aren't too happy about that move...
en: CAL: Looks like the locals aren't too happy about that move...
ja: キャル: どうやら地元の子たちは、あの一撃が気に入らなかったみたいだ……

key: Medicham!
en: Medicham!
ja: チャーレム!

key: CAL: We've got your back-- you just keep the mountain stable!
en: CAL: We've got your back-- you just keep the mountain stable!
ja: キャル: 僕たちがついてる――君はこの山を安定させることだけ考えて!

key: BLAKE: Don't have to tell me twice.
en: BLAKE: Don't have to tell me twice.
ja: ブレイク: 言われなくても分かってるさ。

key: This is our home in the first place, fuckers!
en: This is our home in the first place, fuckers!
ja: ここは元々俺たちの地元なんだよ、クソ野郎ども!

key: You wanna burn it down?!
en: You wanna burn it down?!
ja: それを燃やそうってのか!?

key: I've had just about goddamn enough of that!
en: I've had just about goddamn enough of that!
ja: そういうのは、もううんざりなんだよ!

key: Chin up, head high-- don't flinch when he hits you.
en: Chin up, head high-- don't flinch when he hits you.
ja: 顎を上げて、頭を高く上げてろ――殴られてもひるむな。

key: Told me that every time he swung.
en: Told me that every time he swung.
ja: あいつは殴るたびに、そう言ってきた。

key: And while you were out there crying about it, whining like the snivelling brat you were, I stopped flinching.
en: And while you were out there crying about it, whining like the snivelling brat you were, I stopped flinching.
ja: それでお前がそのことでずっと泣いて、めそめそ文句垂れてるガキみたいにしてる間に、俺はひるまなくなった。

key: Started swinging instead.
en: Started swinging instead.
ja: 代わりに、自分から殴るようになった。

key: That was the safest way.
en: That was the safest way.
ja: それが一番安全なやり方だったんだ。

key: Not anymore!
en: Not anymore!
ja: でも、もう違う!

key: I'm taking a stand and making cringe speeches while doing it!
en: I'm taking a stand and making cringe speeches while doing it!
ja: 立ち向かって、そのついでに恥ずかしいスピーチだってしてやるさ!

key: You with me, bro?!
en: You with me, bro?!
ja: ついてくるよな、兄弟!?

key: CAL: I'm with you.
en: CAL: I'm with you.
ja: キャル: 一緒にいるよ。

key: Go find that Heatran, \PN!
en: Go find that Heatran, \PN!
ja: \PN、ヒードランを見つけに行ってくれ!

key: It has to be close!
en: It has to be close!
ja: 近くにいるはずだ!

key: BLAKE: And when you do--
en: BLAKE: And when you do--
ja: ブレイク: で、見つけたら――

key: Don't flinch.
en: Don't flinch.
ja: ひるむなよ。

key: HEATRAN: Hiiiiaah!
en: HEATRAN: Hiiiiaah!
ja: ヒードラン: ヒィィァァ!

key: Horra!
en: Horra!
ja: ホラアッ!

key: HEATRAN: Hhhra~
en: HEATRAN: Hhhra~
ja: ヒードラン: フゥラ〜

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
